summary.improvementInterpretation: Baseline median exceeds cutoff; candidate median is observed. Greater than 43.8% median-time reduction lower bound, not an estimated baseline median or p95. Scoped planning improvement exceeds 20%; 30-second affordability goal remains open.
summary.firstInboxInterpretation: Candidate median is 45.54 ms higher (+4.25%); small N and shared-host noise do not establish a regression or a first-render win. No first-inbox result substitutes for full acquisition.
summary.fullDatasetEquality: All ten candidates have the same full physical message content hash; later samples additionally compare every message ID/body to supported population. Eight public-query physical reopens preserve that hash and held history/search results.

checkpointControls.protocol: Existing beforeReplace correctness barrier blocks next transaction at >=1,000 messages; Chromium closes with exactly 950 physically durable. Reopen owner-cut, verify held history/search; queue send, physical reopen again, compare intent/IDs and pending row; restore transport and observe target intent committed plus /api/resume 200. Separate from performance.

foregroundControls.qualification: Unresolved for both variants; online public mutation did not resolve before external timeout. No admission, settlement, receiver or frame-gap latency claimed. FIFO draining is only a source-informed hypothesis.
